pages.body:
Harvard in Tech connects Harvard alumni, students, and affiliates working across technology — founders and engineers, investors and designers, policy people and product people.

### How we started

What began in 2013 as a handful of alumni trading introductions over email is now a community of more than 8,000 people across five chapters and two interest-based groups. There is no membership fee and no application. If you are Harvard-affiliated and you work in or around technology, you are already one of us.

### What we actually do

Most of what happens here happens between people, not on a stage. The events are the visible part — panels, fireside chats, chapter dinners — but the durable value is the introduction someone makes on your behalf a year after you met them.

> The best thing this community ever did for me was a five-minute conversation at a New York dinner that turned into my co-founder.

### Getting involved

Come to something in your city. Join the WhatsApp group. Volunteer for a project. None of it requires a commitment beyond the thing itself.
